subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The love between them is __blooming__.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Fading.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words: 
 
 
• **"Blooming" means to develop good, attractive, or successful qualities** (प्रस्फुटन)**.**

 
 
• Example: She's in blooming health.
 
 
 
• **"Fading" means losing brightness, color, or strength** (क्षीण).
 
 
• ​Example: Hopes of peace settlement is fading.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the antonym of "blooming" is "fading".
 
• The love between them is not thriving or developing, but rather diminishing or weakening. 
 
• Grammatically, **"blooming" is a present participle verb used as an adjective to describe the state of the love, while "fading" is also a present participle verb used as an adjective to describe the opposite state.**

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Option 1: "Flourishing" means thriving or prospering, which is a synonym of "blooming". (समृद्धि)
 
• Option 2: "Sprouting" means beginning to grow or develop, which is a similar idea to "blooming" but not an antonym. (अंकुरित)
 
• Option 3: "Growing" means increasing or expanding, which is also a similar idea to "blooming" but not an antonym. (बढ़ता हुआ)
